title: rbac v2: enforce KMS region pinning + audit logging hardening
author: Aisha Kumar
description: Motivation: tighten RBAC v2 policy enforcement for KMS region residency and improve audit logging fidelity after recent compliance review. This PR adds enforcement checks for KMS key region pinning, enables stricter residency policies by default behind a rollout flag, and hardens audit logging with structured fields and export hooks for downstream ingestion. Summary of changes: 1) Policy enforcement: implement server-side enforcement path that rejects create/update requests for resources that violate KMS region pinning when the organization policy is set to 'enforce'; previously we only surfaced audit warnings. 2) KMS integration: add key metadata validation that verifies key ARN/region against tenant residency configuration and a mapping cache with TTL for account->preferred-region. 3) Audit logging: extend structured audit log schema with fields {policy_check, kms_key_region, residency_violation, enforcement_decision, correlation_id}, include decision context and policy_id, and add a buffered exporter for secure delivery to internal audit sink (TLS + auth). 4) Migration and rollout: introduce feature flag rollout.rbac_v2.kms_residency_enforce with gradual percentage rollout and automatic rollback on increased 5xx rate. 5) Tests and CI: unit tests for policy evaluation, integration tests exercising KMS stub behavior across regions, and e2e smoke that verifies both audit-only and enforce modes. Commits: [1] impl: add enforcement path for kms residency (aisha/impl-kms-enforce) [2] feat: structured audit log schema + exporter (aisha/audit-schema) [3] test: integration tests with kms stubs (aisha/kms-tests) [4] ci: add matrix for kms-region variations (aisha/ci-kms-matrix) Rollout notes: guarded behind rollout flag; default set to audit mode for existing tenants; new tenants created after 2025-02-20 will default to 'enforce' based on compliance profile. Monitoring: added SLO and alerting rule to detect >1% increase in API errors for policy-check endpoints and added dashboards for audit-log export failures. Backwards compatibility: audit-only mode preserved; enforcement is opt-in per org until flag reaches 100%. Related work: Linear ENG-2174, SEC-89. Checklist: - [x] Unit tests - [x] Integration tests - [x] E2E smoke - [x] Docs/console feature-flag UI - [x] Security review - [x] Canary rollout plan

release_notes: Enforcement: Add optional enforcement for KMS region pinning under feature flag rollout.rbac_v2.kms_residency_enforce. Audit logging: Structured audit logs include policy decision context and KMS region metadata. Migration: rollout plan and monitoring added.
review_comments: Lina Park: We should ensure the region cache TTL is configurable per-deployment; otherwise cross-region failover could cause incorrect rejections. Author reply: added config and unit tests for TTL (see region_validator.go).

Ravi Patel: Audit schema looks good; please include correlation_id in all code paths including rejects. Author reply: correlation_id added and propagated through middleware. Test added in exporter_test.go.
Morgan Chen: Can we add a canary for 10% traffic for 24h before increasing? Author reply: rollout flag supports percentage rollout; canary plan added to ops/runbook and automation is in rollout.go.
